ns2:course.label: Info Needs of Part Communities
ns2:course.description: Special topics sections for in-depth study of the characteristics and information needs of specialist users of libraries; goals and objectives, policies, and services; reference and bibliographical aids; and effective services that satisfy these special needs. Prerequisite: LIS 504 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: LIS 504 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC.
